hotels.title: Crete Oceanfront Suites & Villas on Private Beach with Six Senses Spa
hotels.description: Discover the epitome of secluded luxury at Elounda Peninsula Luxury Resort, where 58 exclusive suites and villas cascade down to two private sandy beaches. Spend your days drifting between your terrace and the resort's exclusive beachfront, pausing for signature treatments at the Six Senses Spa or savouring Mediterranean flavours at waterside dining venues like Il Borro Tuscan Bistro and Sumosan. Between the resort's sandy beach and the charming harbour villages dotting Crete's coast, every moment invites you to slow down and savour the very best of island living.
